query: My Nexa Fold X1 inner screen stopped working by itself; it shows no image and doesn't respond to touch, while the outer cover screen still works.

contexts.goal: Follow these steps to perform this Data Access Troubleshooting
contexts.title: Data access fix

steps: Even if you can no longer use the touchscreen, access data, such as pictures or messages, using a USB mouse.
Connect the adapter to your phone.
Connect the mouse's USB to the adapter.
Connect a keyboard the same way, so you are able to easily enter your PIN or Password.
Once you've backed up your data, visit a TechCorp walk-in service center, or you can schedule a repair service online.

actions.description: It will back up your data

steps: If your phone's screen is damaged and you can no longer see anything on it, back up your data by connecting it to your TV or monitor.
With some devices, use a device like a DeX station or multi-port adapter to connect a mouse and keyboard in addition to HDMI.
Connect the adapter to your phone.
Connect the HDMI cable to the adapter.
Connect the other end of the HDMI cable to the HDMI port on the TV or monitor.
Power on your TV or monitor.
Select the input that your phone is connected to.
From here, mimic movements on your phone to back up your data with Data Transfer or other methods.
Once you've backed up your data, visit a TechCorp walk-in service center, or you can schedule a repair service online.
